Manage assets

Usage:
  kernel asset [command]

Available Commands:
  clean       Clean unused assets
  stat        Show asset file info
  unused      List unused assets
  upload      Upload files to workspace assets

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for asset

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            dry run mode: validate and print what would happen without making changes
  -f, --format string      output format: table | json (default "table")
  -v, --log-level string   log level: off | trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal (defaults to conf.json system.logLevel)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace path

Use "kernel asset [command] --help" for more information about a command.
